title: Choose the visual direction
question: The roll assigned the Service Manual Index. Choose it, adopt an alternate, or re-roll. Every direction keeps the agreed content, routes, palette, and contact path.

options.label: Service Manual Index
options.lineage: Industrial service manuals and parts lists
options.thesis: A precise, human-readable index of current work and the technical archive behind it.
options.viewport: The name and role sit on a manual cover; two current projects occupy the main work plate; Articles, Cheatsheets, and Projects read as direct index entries.
options.risk: Too much machine language could make a personal portfolio feel impersonal.

raised.raise: Use accent color only to clarify a path or active state.
Keep current work visibly at the surface and the historical archive one clear step deeper.
Give navigation one deliberate active state, with no decorative looping motion.
Reserve one quiet, human sentence inside the technical index.

options.label: Three Routes Through the Work
options.lineage: Railway wayfinding maps and interchange diagrams
options.thesis: A small route map makes the portfolio’s next useful destination obvious.
options.viewport: Fabio Rosado is the origin; two featured projects are the largest destinations; clearly labeled routes lead to Articles, Cheatsheets, Projects, and LinkedIn.
options.risk: If the lines stop acting as real links, the map becomes decoration.

options.label: Star Atlas of Work
options.lineage: Celestial star atlases and coordinate charts
options.thesis: A precise chart lets technical work and writing be explored as a field of labeled points.
options.viewport: Two featured projects are the brightest labeled objects; the article and archive links form a measured index alongside them.
options.risk: The astronomy language could obscure the direct paths employers and readers need.
options.case: Holds audience identification through technical charts and data graphics; loses narrowly on product clarity because the star-map metaphor adds translation.

options.label: Work in One Broadside
options.thesis: One high-contrast printed sheet gives current work and writing an unmistakable voice.
options.viewport: A large name and role lead a single print surface; the two current projects take clear top billing, with writing and archives arranged below.
options.risk: Large lettering can consume the room needed for scanning and long-form reading.
options.case: Holds product clarity with a strict hierarchy and direct labels; loses on audience identification because dancehall billing carries an unrelated cultural code.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.lineage: Surreal gardens with local gravity fields
options.thesis: A landscape of changing forces invites exploratory browsing.
options.viewport: Browse regions by cloud, direction, and destination.
options.risk: The visual system competes with the portfolio’s actual routes.
options.case: Loses on audience identification and product clarity; the metaphor supplies no useful route that the site actually contains.
options.kept: Color will still mark real navigation and active states, never serve as decoration.

options.label: Mesophotic Deep Dive
options.lineage: Technical dive charts and mesophotic field records
options.thesis: Descending layers turn a complex subject into a sequence of discoveries.
options.viewport: Move from surface entries through a vertical dive profile into selected observations.
options.risk: The ocean story is unrelated to Fabio’s current work.
options.case: Loses on audience identification and product clarity; the subject itself creates a false signal.
options.kept: The hierarchy will distinguish current work from deeper historical archives.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: A running step row gives a collection a visible, repeating pulse.
options.viewport: The first view uses a sixteen-step row as a browsable timeline.
options.risk: A sequencer suggests audio features the portfolio does not have.
options.case: Loses on audience identification and product clarity; a continuous loop would add needless motion.
options.kept: Navigation gets one restrained active indicator and no decorative loop.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.lineage: Personal homepages and decorated diary rooms
options.thesis: A small room makes a personal profile feel inhabited.
options.viewport: A profile room sits beside a diary and friend ledger.
options.risk: Visitor counts and furnishings suggest social features that no longer exist.
options.case: Loses on audience identification and product clarity; its interaction model is absent from the requested site.
options.kept: A single concise personal note will balance the project index.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional portfolio, executed with sharp hierarchy and the confirmed brand colors.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role in a hero, two featured project cards, recent writing, a short About section, and social links.
canonCard.risk: The composition is familiar by design and may feel close to the supplied references.
